name: Place order button
description: Places the cart as an order with the checkout's choices, then opens tracking.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/place-order-button", name: "Place order button", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Places the cart as an order with the checkout's choices, then opens tracking.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Button(label: cart.count > 0 ? "Place order · ${formatMoney(checkout.quote.total_cents)}" : "Your cart is empty", fullWidth: true, size: Size.lg, disabled: cart.count == 0, onTap: PlaceOrder(fulfilment: checkout.fulfilment))
  )], data: [Data(name: "cart", from: Client.cart(), fetch: "client", type: Cart), Data(name: "checkout", from: Client.checkout(), fetch: "client", type: ClientCheckout)],
)
